Delhi Building Collapse: Two people were killed after a building slab collapsed in Delhi’s Harsh Vihar on October 25, triggering a multi-agency rescue operation. The incident has renewed concerns over construction safety and unauthorised structures in the capital, following deadly building collapses in New Seemapuri and Satya Niketan in recent months.
